title.en: Reefs of the Murex: Deep-Sea Mollusk Harvesting
title.fr: Les récifs du Murex : Récolte des coquillages pourpres
title.ar-IQ: جمع أصداف الموريكس في مياه صور

acts.enrichment_hook: Investigate how Tyrian divers trapped Hexaplex trunculus mollusks with baited wicker baskets along the offshore sandstone reefs.

5-7.learning_objective: Discover how ancient Tyrian divers collected colorful sea snails from offshore reefs using gentle wicker baskets.
5-7.narrative_hook: Splash into the calm harbor shallows to find purple sea shells resting on the sunlit rocks!

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Ahlan, young diver! Look into the clear water—see the bumpy sea shells waiting on the reef?
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: أهلاً يا بطل! شوف الأصداف الحلوة عم تلمع تحت المي الصافية.

player_actions: Spot 3 shining sea shells on the sandy seafloor
Place each shell carefully in the woven wicker basket
Bring the basket back to King Hiram's harbor quay
hint_ladder: Look for the purple sparkle near the sea grass
Tap on the wicker basket to collect your shells
5-7.completion_criteria: Collect 3 sea shells and deliver them to the harbor dock.
5-7.historical_notes: Early learners explore marine life and Phoenician coastal fishing techniques safely through visual storytelling.

8-10.learning_objective: Understand the ecological habitats of Hexaplex trunculus and how baited mesh traps harvested dye snails sustainably.
8-10.narrative_hook: Bait the wicker mesh traps with fresh cockles and lower them into the rocky reefs facing the Sidonian harbor.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Marhaban! In Tyre we place our woven baskets where the waves break against the sandstone reefs.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: مرحبا! منرمي السلال بين الصخور حتى نجمع أصداف الموريكس من مية البحر.

player_actions: Equip bait inside 2 woven wicker mollusk baskets
Lower baskets along the northern reef margin
Harvest 10 Hexaplex trunculus mollusks and 3 cedar beams for drying frames
hint_ladder: The snails feed primarily on rocky surfaces in moderate currents
Check both sides of the sandstone reef
8-10.completion_criteria: Harvest 10 mollusks and assemble the drying frame on the quay.
8-10.historical_notes: Pliny the Elder documented that Phoenician snail traps used open-weave wicker mesh baited with small fish.

11-13.learning_objective: Calculate the industrial scale of Tyrian dye production: 10,000 snails per gram of dye and its environmental footprint.
11-13.narrative_hook: Survey the offshore sandstone reefs and analyze why ancient Tyrians developed offshore harvesting fleets to meet global Mediterranean demand.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Welcome, explorer! It requires 10,000 snails to dye the border of a single royal cloak. Let us measure our harvest.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: أهلاً بك! صناعة غرام واحد من الأرجوان بتحتاج عشرة آلاف صدفة، خلينا نحسب المحصول بدقة.

player_actions: Calculate mollusk density along the 1-hectare southern harbor basin
Sort predatory Hexaplex trunculus from non-dye marine species
Deliver harvest quotas to the designated downwind processing quarter
hint_ladder: Hexaplex trunculus features distinctive spiral whorls and spines
Industrial workshops are situated downwind to avoid residential contamination
11-13.completion_criteria: Sort 10 valid dye specimens and position processing stations downwind.
11-13.historical_notes: Experimental archaeology shows 12,000 snails yield approximately 1.4 grams of pure dibromoindigo.

14-17.learning_objective: Evaluate the geoarchaeological evidence of Tyrian marine exploitation, shell mounds, and Iron Age luxury monopolies.
14-17.narrative_hook: Investigate stratified mollusk mounds at Tyre and Sidon, correlating zooarchaeological data with Mediterranean luxury trade monopolies.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Greetings, scholar. The massive shell mounds of our coastline testify to an industrial monopoly that fueled our civilization for two millennia.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: تحياتي يا باحث. تلال الأصداف الصورية شاهد أثري على أضخم احتكار صناعي بالبحر المتوسط.

player_actions: Correlate stratigraphy of crushed Murex shell layers with Iron Age chronology
Analyze biological taxonomy of Bolinus brandaris vs Hexaplex trunculus
Synthesize environmental trade-offs between odor-intensive industrial zones and civic elite quarters
hint_ladder: Bolinus brandaris produces pure purple, while Hexaplex trunculus yields bluish-purple hues
Examine the 40-meter shell mound excavated at Sidon as comparative benchmark
14-17.completion_criteria: Complete stratigraphic analysis and publish findings to the Tyre Research Archive.
14-17.historical_notes: Chemical chromatography (HPLC) has confirmed dibromoindigo markers on elite textiles across Near Eastern royal burials.

title.en: Ships of Tarshish: Ophir Expeditions & Silver Shekel Assays
title.fr: Les vaisseaux de Tarsis : Expéditions d'Ophir et sicles d'argent
title.ar-LB: سفن ترشيش ورحلات أوفير وتجارة الشيكل
title.ar-IQ: أسطول سفن ترشيش وتجارة الفضة والذهب
title.ko: 다시스의 배: 오피르 원정과 은 셰켈 교역

acts.enrichment_hook: Chart the joint Tyrian-Solomonic expeditions from Ezion-Geber to Ophir and master the metallurgical assay of the silver Shekel of Tyre.

5-7.learning_objective: Learn how friendly sailors loaded big wooden boats with shiny silver coins and purple blankets to trade with neighbors.
5-7.narrative_hook: Help King Hiram load the grand sailing ship with warm purple cloth and shiny coins!

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Welcome aboard! Let us count our trade blankets and shiny silver tokens together.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: أهلاً فيك على السفينة! تعال نعد الأقمشة البنفسجية والقطع الفضية سوا.

player_actions: Stack 2 bundles of purple cloth in the ship hold
Count 5 silver coins into the merchant pouch
Wave farewell as the ship sets sail
hint_ladder: Put the soft cloth near the center mast
Coins belong in the velvet pouch
5-7.completion_criteria: Load all cargo items and complete the trade count.
5-7.historical_notes: Introduces basic counting and Mediterranean maritime cooperation.

8-10.learning_objective: Trace the 3-year voyage of Ships of Tarshish from Ezion-Geber to Ophir and understand currency barter.
8-10.narrative_hook: Negotiate trade terms for gold, peacock feathers, and ivory from Ophir using Tyrian purple and silver shekels.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Our deep-sea galleys return every three years with wondrous goods. Let us balance the scales!
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: سفننا بترجع كل تلات سنين حاملة الذهب والعاج، خلينا نوزن البضائع بالميزان.

player_actions: Weigh silver shekels on the balance scale
Exchange 5 shekels and 2 purple robes for 1 Ophir gold ingot
Log the transaction in the harbor ledger
hint_ladder: Ensure the balance scale indicators align horizontally
Record the exchange rate in King Hiram's ledger
8-10.completion_criteria: Balance the trade scale and record the ledger entry.
8-10.historical_notes: Biblical 1 Kings 10:22 records joint Hiramic-Solomonic expeditions returning every three years with exotic goods.

11-13.learning_objective: Analyze the dual-monopoly of Tyre: controlling Atlantic/Mediterranean routes to Tarshish and Red Sea routes to Ophir.
11-13.narrative_hook: Plan the logistics of a joint expedition sailing from the Gulf of Aqaba (Ezion-Geber) through the Red Sea.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: By partnering with Solomon, Tyre secured access to the southern oceans without needing an overland conquest.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: بالتحالف مع سليمان، صور فتحت خطوط التجارة للمحيط الهندي بدون حروب.

player_actions: Chart seasonal monsoon winds across the Red Sea and Arabian Sea
Calculate cargo capacity for deep-hulled Ships of Tarshish
Validate 95% silver assay purity of Tyrian shekels against Near Eastern standards
hint_ladder: Summer winds blow southward down the Red Sea, aiding outbound voyages
Assay testing requires measuring specific gravity in water
11-13.completion_criteria: Plot the navigation course and verify the bullion assay purity.
11-13.historical_notes: 'Ships of Tarshish' was a technical Phoenician term for heavy open-water ore-carriers, not just ships bound for Tartessos.

14-17.learning_objective: Critique the geopolitical economics of the Tyrian shekel as the mandatory temple currency in Second Temple Jerusalem.
14-17.narrative_hook: Investigate why Jewish authorities in Jerusalem mandated pagan coins bearing Melqart's image for the sacred half-shekel temple tax.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Consider the historical irony: our patron god Melqart's face was accepted in the Jerusalem Temple because our silver purity never wavered.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: تأمل المفارقة التاريخية: نقاوة الفضة الصورية خلت عملة صور مقدسة بكل أسواق ومعابد الشرق.

player_actions: Compare metallurgical assays of Roman imperial denarii (declining silver) with Tyrian shekels (constant 94-98%)
Read Mishnah Bekhorot 8:7 regarding the halakhic mandate for Tyrian silver
Trace the historical transmission from Solomon's temple artisans to Hellenistic coin production
hint_ladder: Roman denarii were progressively debased with copper, whereas Tyrian shekels maintained 95% fine silver
Refer to numismatic catalogs of the British Museum and National Museum of Beirut
14-17.completion_criteria: Submit comparative numismatic report explaining temple tax monetary mandates.
14-17.historical_notes: The high silver content of Tyrian shekels explains why they were required for the Temple tax and were the thirty pieces of silver.

title.fr: Brise-lames portuaires et ingénierie du brûlot
title.ar-LB: كواسر أمواج الميناء وهندسة الحراقة البحرية
title.ar-EG: بناء كواسر أمواج صور وهندسة سفينة النار
title.ar-IQ: بناء كواسر الأمواج وتكتيكات سفينة النار

acts.enrichment_hook: Construct submerged ashlar breakwaters with 2.25-meter header blocks and design the combustible fireship counter-tactic.

5-7.learning_objective: Discover how strong stone blocks fit together like building bricks to protect boats from giant waves.
5-7.narrative_hook: Stack big golden stones in the harbor water to make a peaceful pool for your wooden boat!

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Hello, little builder! Let us place heavy stones side by side so the crashing waves turn gentle.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: مرحبا يا شاطر! تعال نحط الأحجار الكبيرة حداً لبعض حتى نوقف الموج القوي.

player_actions: Pick up 3 stone blocks with the harbor crane
Fit the blocks into the breakwater outline
Watch the rough water turn calm behind your new wall
hint_ladder: Rotate the block until it snaps into the green outline
Fit all three blocks to complete the harbor wall
5-7.completion_criteria: Complete the breakwater puzzle and test wave calmness.
5-7.historical_notes: Teaches fundamental structural stability and harbor protection concepts.

8-10.learning_objective: Understand ashlar header masonry and the physics of the Tyrian fireship counter-measure.
8-10.narrative_hook: Lay 2.25-meter header stones along the Sidonian jetty and outfit a defensive vessel with suspended oil cauldrons.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Headers absorb kinetic wave energy. And when enemy towers threaten, our fireship uses wind and pitch to defend our walls!
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: أحجار الرباط بتمتص قوة الموج. ووقت الخطر، الحراقة البحرية بتحمي أسوارنا!

player_actions: Place 4 ashlar header blocks perpendicular to wave direction
Ballast the stern of the horse transport vessel to raise its bow
Suspend dual oil cauldrons from the main masts
hint_ladder: Adding stone ballast to the stern tilts the front of the ship upward
Suspended cauldrons must hang over the bow to ignite targets upon impact
8-10.completion_criteria: Construct the jetty section and configure the fireship payload.
8-10.historical_notes: Arrian describes Tyrian engineers weighting the fireship's stern with sand and ballast to lift its bow over Macedonian barriers.

11-13.learning_objective: Analyze naval siege mechanics: Macedonian artillery towers versus Tyrian kinetic fireship strikes in 332 BCE.
11-13.narrative_hook: Simulate the hydrodynamics of Alexander's 60-meter-wide mole and calculate the burn radius of the Tyrian fireship.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Alexander built siege towers covered in hides against our arrows. But he did not anticipate our naval chemistry!
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: الإسكندر بنى أبراج ضخمة مكسية بالجلد ضد السهام، بس ما كان حاسب حساب الكيمياء البحرية الصورية!

player_actions: Calculate thermal output of sulfur, pitch, and volatile oil mixtures
Adjust fireship sail orientation to catch south-westerly offshore breezes
Simulate mast fracture releasing liquid fire directly onto siege engines
hint_ladder: Fireship launch requires favorable prevailing winds blowing toward the mole
Dual cauldrons snap forward when the hull strikes the wooden causeway piers
11-13.completion_criteria: Achieve successful fireship collision trajectory and neutralize siege engines.
11-13.historical_notes: The destruction of Alexander's siege towers halted work on the mole until he assembled an allied fleet at Sidon.

14-17.learning_objective: Evaluate maritime structural engineering: submerged header breakwaters, acoustic wave dissipation, and mole-driven tombolo formation.
14-17.narrative_hook: Investigate underwater archaeological surveys of the Sidonian and Egyptian harbors and model the geomorphological effects of Alexander's mole.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Observe how human engineering reshaped geology: Alexander built a mole to conquer us, and nature responded by burying our southern harbor in sand.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: تأمل كيف غيرت الهندسة وجه الجيولوجيا: الإسكندر بنى السد ليحاصرنا، والبحر دفن الميناء الجنوبي بالرمل للأبد.

player_actions: Analyze underwater header block dimensions (2.25m x 0.45m) discovered in northern harbor surveys
Model longshore sediment drift interruption and 30,000–50,000 m³/year sand accumulation
Map Roman bath construction atop the silted Egyptian harbor basin
hint_ladder: Header stones interlock perpendicular to the shoreline to prevent lateral displacement
Refer to Marriner et al. (PNAS 2007) for bathymetric core data
14-17.completion_criteria: Publish 3D geoarchaeological reconstruction of pre- and post-siege Tyre.
14-17.historical_notes: Alexander's 60m mole permanently transformed an offshore island half a mile out into a mainland peninsula.

title.en: The Imperial Dye Vats: Synthesizing Dibromoindigo
title.fr: Les cuves impériales : Synthèse du dibromoindigo
title.ar-IQ: مراجل استخلاص صباغ الأرجوان في صور

acts.mentor_name: Bodashtart of the Temple of Melqart
acts.enrichment_hook: Follow Pliny the Elder's 10-day chemical recipe to extract chromogens and brew authentic dibromoindigo in lead vats.

5-7.learning_objective: See how sunlight and warm pots magically turn colorless sea shell juice into radiant purple paint.
5-7.narrative_hook: Put your sea shells out in the sunshine and watch the colors change like a sunset!

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Look closely! As the warm sunshine touches the shell drop, it turns from pale yellow to bright royal purple!
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: شوف كيف لما تدق الشمس بنقطة الصدفة بتتحول للون بنفسجي ملكي ساحر!

player_actions: Place 3 droplet samples onto the sunlit stone table
Watch the colors transition: yellow -> green -> blue -> deep purple
Dip a white linen cloth into the purple bowl
hint_ladder: Sunshine activates the color transformation
Leave the cloth in the bowl until the purple glows
5-7.completion_criteria: Complete the color transformation sequence and dye 1 linen cloth.
5-7.historical_notes: Introduces photochemical color synthesis through visual discovery.

8-10.learning_objective: Understand the 10-day simmering process documented by Pliny: alkaline ash, salt brine, and lead pots.
8-10.narrative_hook: Manage the temperature of the coastal dye vat and mix the wood-ash brine without overheating.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Patience is our greatest secret: the mixture must simmer gently for ten days in our lead cauldron.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: سر الأرجوان بالصبر: الخليط لازم يغلي على نار هادية عشر إيام بمرجل الرصاص.

player_actions: Add crushed gland extract to the lead vat
Pour in wood ash and sea salt solution
Maintain simmering flame indicator between 60°C and 80°C for 10 virtual days
hint_ladder: Do not let the flame turn red or the dye will scorch
Stir the cauldron when steam rises
8-10.completion_criteria: Simmer the dye vat to optimal saturation and dye 2 royal textiles.
8-10.historical_notes: Pliny the Elder noted lead vats were preferred over bronze because tin/lead did not discolor the purple hue.

11-13.learning_objective: Examine the organic chemistry of 6,6'-dibromoindigo and why oxidation is required to produce color.
11-13.narrative_hook: Follow the molecular chain reaction from colorless indoxyl precursors to insoluble purple pigment crystals.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: The living snail has no purple inside; only when its secret juices meet air and sun does Melqart's purple awaken.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: الحلزون ما عنده لون بنفسجي وهو عايش؛ بس لما تلتقي المادة بالهوا والشمس بيولد الأرجوان.

player_actions: Monitor enzymatic hydrolysis of tyrindoxyl sulfate into tyrindoxyl
Introduce oxygen to stimulate photochemical oxidation into tyriverdin
Synthesize pure 6,6'-dibromoindigo through alkaline reduction and aeration
hint_ladder: Enzymes require neutral pH before alkaline steeping
Sunlight is crucial to convert green intermediates into purple
11-13.completion_criteria: Achieve 98% dye purity and stabilize the pigment on cedar mordant.
11-13.historical_notes: Dibromoindigo (C16H8Br2N2O2) is one of the earliest chemically synthesized natural organohalogen pigments.

14-17.learning_objective: Critique Pliny's Naturalis Historia Book IX, analyzing ancient industrial zoning and olfactory regulations in Tyre.
14-17.narrative_hook: Evaluate urban planning in island Tyre: why industrial dye vats were strictly zoned along coastal margins downwind from residential estates.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Tyre was the wealthiest city in the Levant, but Strabo wrote that its dye vats made it foul to live in. Let us investigate ancient industrial zoning.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: كانت صور أغنى مدن الشرق، بس المؤرخين كتبوا إن ريحة الصباغ كانت صعبة، عشان هيك عزلوا المعامل على أطراف البحر.

player_actions: Translate passage from Pliny Natural History IX.60–65 regarding lead vat simmering
Overlay prevailing wind rose data against Tyre's archaeological residential quarters
Draft ancient civic sanitation proposal balancing industrial wealth with public comfort
hint_ladder: Mediterranean westerlies and south-westerlies blow toward the mainland during daytime
Industrial workshops were located on the southern and eastern rocky fringes
14-17.completion_criteria: Submit urban zoning audit resolving industrial emissions and economic output.
14-17.historical_notes: Strabo (Geography XVI.2.23) remarked that Tyre's dye works made the city unpleasant to visit, yet created unparalleled civic wealth.

title.en: The Council of Melqart: Deciphering the Vassal Treaty
title.fr: Le Conseil de Melqart : Décryptage du traité de vassalité
title.ar-LB: مجلس ملقارت وفك رموز معاهدة أسرحدون
title.ar-EG: مجلس معبد ملقارت وفك رموز معاهدة صور
title.ar-IQ: مجلس ملقارت وفك نصوص معاهدة أسرحدون المسمارية

acts.mentor_name: Bodashtart of the Temple of Melqart
acts.enrichment_hook: Decipher the cuneiform clauses of the 672 BCE Vassal Treaty of Esarhaddon, protect shipwreck salvage rights, and formulate council policy.

5-7.learning_objective: Match ancient letter symbols and learn that words helped ancient leaders make peaceful agreements.
5-7.narrative_hook: Help Bodashtart match Phoenician letter symbols on the stone tablet to unlock the temple gates!

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Welcome to the grand hall! Can you help me find the letter that looks like an ox head and water waves?
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: أهلاً بك بالمعبد الكبير! فيك تساعدني لاقي حرف الألف والميم المنقوشين عالصخر؟

player_actions: Match 3 Phoenician letters: Aleph (Ox), Mem (Water), Resh (Head)
Stamp the clay seal with King Hiram's insignia
Open the temple archive chest
hint_ladder: Aleph looks like horns pointing up
Mem has zigzag waves like the blue sea
5-7.completion_criteria: Match 3 letter symbols and stamp the clay seal.
5-7.historical_notes: Connects Phoenician pictographic origins to early alphabetic phonetics.

8-10.learning_objective: Read translated clauses of Esarhaddon's treaty and explore how the Phoenician pantheon guaranteed agreements.
8-10.narrative_hook: Read the clay treaty to see why the Assyrian king invoked Melqart and Eshmun to watch over ship agreements.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: On this clay tablet, King Esarhaddon wrote that if our ships were wrecked, his officers would take the cargo. We must know our rights!
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: بهاللوح الفخاري، كتب أسرحدون شروط قاسية عن السفن الغارقة، لازم نعرف كل كلمة مكتوبة.

player_actions: Translate 3 treaty clauses regarding coastal road access and shipwreck salvage
Identify Phoenician deities: Melqart, Eshmun, and Ba'al-Saphon
Advise King Ba'al I on maritime trade protections
hint_ladder: Pilistu refers to the southern coastal regions along the Levant
Ba'al-Saphon was the lord of sea storms and mountain tempests
8-10.completion_criteria: Correctly identify treaty clauses and record council advice.
8-10.historical_notes: The Vassal Treaty of Esarhaddon (SAA II, 5) explicitly lists Tyre's Phoenician pantheon alongside Assyrian gods.

11-13.learning_objective: Analyze diplomatic leverage in ancient siege crises: shoftim governance versus hereditary monarchy.
11-13.narrative_hook: Evaluate how Tyre transitioned from kingly rule to elected judges (shoftim) after surviving Nebuchadnezzar's 13-year siege.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: After thirteen years of siege, our people chose judges—shoftim—to govern alongside our council of elders.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: بعد تلطاشر سنة حصار، أهل صور اختاروا قضاة شرفاء (شوفطيم) ليديروا المدينة بالعدل والشورى.

player_actions: Compare the Tyrian shoftim system with Carthaginian suffetes
Review Ezekiel 26–29 contemporary accounts of the Babylonian stalemate
Debate Alexander's sacrificial ultimatum in the Assembly of Elders
hint_ladder: Shoftim were civil magistrates elected for one-to-seven year terms
Sacrificing in the island temple symbolized accepting Macedonian suzerainty
11-13.completion_criteria: Resolve the council deliberation vote and record the consensus.
11-13.historical_notes: The Phoenician term 'shofet' (plural shoftim) is cognate with Hebrew shophet (judge) and Punic suffete.

14-17.learning_objective: Conduct epigraphic and historiographical synthesis of Near Eastern vassal treaties, royal annals, and Hellenistic Casus Belli.
14-17.narrative_hook: Critique the legal rhetoric of the Vassal Treaty of Esarhaddon and analyze the diplomatic Casus Belli of Alexander's 332 BCE siege.

npc_lines.mentor_greeting_en: Sovereignty is defined at the intersection of religion, law, and physical geography. Let us analyze why Azemilcus refused Alexander entry.
npc_lines.mentor_greeting_native: السيادة بتتقرر بالقانون والدبلوماسية والجغرافيا. تعوا نحلل ليش صور رفضت فتح أبواب المعبد للإسكندر.

player_actions: Analyze cuneiform transcription of SAA II, Text 5 lines IV.1–15 (salvage rights and embedded qepu deputy)
Evaluate Heracles-Melqart syncretism and the theological pretext of Alexander's sacrifice
Author a diplomatic white paper on Tyrian geopolitical neutrality during Persian-Hellenistic wars
hint_ladder: The Assyrian 'qepu' acted as a resident imperial commissioner overseeing foreign correspondence
Admitting Alexander to Melqart's shrine constituted de jure surrender of independent island sovereignty
14-17.completion_criteria: Complete peer-reviewed diplomatic synthesis and archive in the Melqart Temple Codex.
14-17.historical_notes: Recovered from Nineveh, Esarhaddon's treaty with Ba'al of Tyre is one of the most complete legal instruments of ancient Near Eastern imperialism.
